name: Prima Assicurazioni
verdict: Italian insurance group 48% held by founder Teodoro D'Ambrosio, with Blackstone 27%, Goldman Sachs 15%, management 8% and Carlyle 2% (as reported in February 2025). Nothing found.
note: Title sponsor of Prima Pramac Yamaha MotoGP, confirmed again for the 2026 season (Yamaha Motor race release, 2026-01-14). Rating note: shareholding as reported by Milano Finanza, 17 February 2025 (prima-assicurazioni-ownership); a reshuffle or listing has been discussed in the Italian press since 2023, so the stakes may have changed since. No state or state fund in the chain; no human-rights finding against Prima or its named owners found (checked 2026-10-03). Prima Seguros, Prima's Spanish brand, is on the upper back of Real Betis's match shirt from 2025-26 to 2027-28 (club announcement, 2025-06-10).
